title: Global stability of Minkowski spacetime for a causal nonlocal gravity model
summary: We establish small-data global existence and decay for the causal-informational nonlocal gravity model CETOmega in 3+1 dimensions. Under harmonic gauge the field equations reduce to a quasilinear hyperbolic system with causal memory generated by a retarded Stieltjes operator K^{-1}.
